column1: PROJECT TEST PLAN - ASTRONAUTS WEB PLATFORM

column2: Astronauts QA Technical Assignment - Task 1 & Task 2

column1: - Verify the end-to-end functionality, UI/UX integrity, and business logic of the Astronauts web platform, prioritizing the Cart and Checkout flow.
- Ensure core e-commerce interactions (adding products, modifying quantities, location address validation, promo vouchers, and price breakdowns) work seamlessly.
- Validate non-functional quality aspects including mobile viewport responsiveness (375px & 430px), performance SLA, and graceful error handling.
- Deliver comprehensive, high-quality test documentation and automated API test suites ensuring zero regression.

column3: Description & Key Scenarios Covered

Item listing, quantity adjustments (+/-), item removal, empty cart state, out-of-stock items, delivery address & lobby disclaimer, delivery notes, voucher code entry, free ongkir threshold, service fees popup, saldo refund, 18+ age verification, checkout CTA enablement.
Location selector, header search bar input, promotional banner carousel auto-scroll & swipe, category grid navigation (Astro Goods, Cafe, Fresh Produce), and sticky bottom navigation bar.
Core third-party payment gateway banking settlements, physical courier GPS tracking in real-time, and warehouse dark-store inventory picking management system.
